info.title: YTB Player
info.author: muratgokce
info.description: YouTube, laid out like the tablet app
info.details:
YTB Player is a YouTube client for Switch homebrew, built on Switch-NewPipe (mirusu400) with the screens redone after YouTube's tablet app. It works with the buttons and the touch screen.

- Home with category chips, Shorts with their own player, channel pages with tabs
- A watch page with comments and replies, related videos and playlists
- Signed in: subscriptions with filters, Watch later, Liked videos, your playlists, notifications
- Player: up to 1080p docked and 720p handheld, a quality and speed menu, chapters, subtitles, SponsorBlock, resume, autoplay
- Sign in over Wi-Fi from a computer: no Google password is typed on the Switch
- English, Turkish and Korean

Its files live in sdmc:/switch/ytb-player/; coming from Switch-NewPipe, the settings, history and login are copied over. Not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
